verdict.rationale: Pomelo's own docs say it notifies the integrator via webhook during 3D Secure so the integrator can deliver the challenge through its own channel. That is a first-party outbound HTTP callback, but it is a single, narrow mention tied to one flow. The adjustments-endpoint mention (Reversal/Refund delivery) hints at further server-to-server callbacks but does not clearly describe webhook subscriptions. Missing for 10: a general event catalog, a documented way to register or subscribe to webhook endpoints, signature/verification and retry semantics, coverage beyond 3DS, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
